note: Tier 2, from a position in which every permanent is as printed. A choose_mana question from a triggered mana ability (605.1b, 605.4a): Fertile Ground ("Enchant land. Whenever enchanted land is tapped for mana, its controller adds an additional one mana of any color.") enchants a Forest; A taps that Forest for {G} as a decision of its own, the trigger resolves at once without the stack and A chooses red; A spends the {R} from the pool on Lightning Bolt at B. Both pass, the Bolt resolves, and the unspent {G} stays in the pool because the main phase has not ended (106.4, 500.5); a land drop is the last decision, made in the state after the Bolt resolved, so that state is recorded. The position is stipulated (spec 2.4), not reached by ordinary play.

transitions.note: Fertile Ground is an enchantment spell, cast in A's main phase with priority and an empty stack (117.1a, 303.1). An Aura spell targets what its enchant ability allows (303.4a, 115.1b, 702.5a): A targets the Forest f1 (601.2c). 601.2g, 601.2h: A taps f2 and f3 for {G} each (305.6) and pays {1}{G}; both are tapped (tier 2). The pool held nothing before and nothing after (the {G}{G} was spent), so no mana fact changes and none is written. 117.3c: A receives priority; A and B pass (implied) and the Aura spell resolves (117.4): its target is still legal (608.3b), so it becomes a permanent and enters the battlefield attached to f1 (608.3c, 303.4). Its controller is A, its owner (default). 117.3b: the active player A receives priority, so the pending question is unchanged and not written.

A, holding priority, activates f1's intrinsic mana ability (305.6, 605.3a) as a decision of its own (spec 5.2). It doesn't use the stack and resolves immediately (605.3b, 405.6c): f1 is tapped and {G} goes into A's pool (106.4). f1 has been tapped for mana (106.12), so Fertile Ground's ability triggers as that mana ability resolves and produces mana (106.12a). It has no target, triggers from the resolution of an activated mana ability and could add mana, so it is a triggered mana ability (605.1b): it doesn't go on the stack and resolves immediately after the mana ability that triggered it, without waiting for priority (605.4a), so it takes no stack id. Resolving, it has f1's controller A add one mana of any color, a choice made while it resolves (608.2d). Spec 5.4: choose_mana is about the source of a mana ability, Fertile Ground.

A chooses red (105.1, 106.1a): {R} is added to A's pool beside the {G} (106.4). Neither carries a restriction (106.6), so both are unrestricted mana. 405.6c: A had priority before the mana ability was activated, so A has priority after it resolves. The pool does not empty: that happens only as a step or phase ends (500.5, 106.4).

Lightning Bolt is an instant (117.1a); "any target" may be a player (115.4), so A targets B (601.2c). 601.2h: A pays {R} with the {R} already in the pool (no mana ability activated, spec 5.8 pool); the {G} stays (106.4a). 117.3c: A receives priority and passes (implied; 117.3d, 106.4b: A announces the {G}); B passes (implied); the Bolt resolves (117.4): its target is legal (608.2b) and it deals 3 damage to B, who loses 3 life, 20 to 17 (120.3a, 119.3). 608.2n: the instant goes to its owner's graveyard. 117.3b: the active player A receives priority; the pending question is unchanged. No step or phase has ended, so A's pool still holds the {G} (106.4, 500.5).

The record's last decision, there to record the state after the Bolt resolved (spec 4.2: only states in which an entry is made are recorded). A has played no land this turn (start assumption) and holds priority in a main phase of A's turn with the stack empty (305.1, 305.2, 116.2a). The Forest enters untapped (default). 116.3: A receives priority afterward; the {G} is still in A's pool. The record ends here.
